    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
    body {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 65ch;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
    h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; }
    p { text-wrap: pretty; }
    p, li, h1, h2, h3 { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
    img, svg, video { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

I haven't changed `0.html`, because it's already a solid starter template and there's nothing in it yet to improve. It has:

- The correct doctype, `lang`, charset and viewport settings.
- Light/dark mode support through `color-scheme`.
- A blank favicon, so the browser doesn't request a missing file.
- Sensible base styles: comfortable line length and spacing, and form controls use the page font.
- Accessibility basics: visible keyboard focus and support for reduced motion.

The only real gaps are small:

1. **Title:** `<title>0</title>` isn't descriptive.
2. **Description:** there's no `<meta name="description">`.
3. **Content:** `<main>` is empty.
